claimCeiling: A proposal records a research suggestion for scrutiny. It does not establish novelty, correctness, importance, tractability, priority, an accepted relationship or a commitment to investigate.
idAlgorithm: proposalId is ep-proposal:sha256:<hex>, computed over canonical JSON of the immutable identity projection defined by tools/atlas-proposals.js; decision receipt IDs use the same algorithm over each receipt projection.
acceptedGraphBoundary: The proposal loader has no write path to data/RELATIONSHIP_REGISTRY.json or the accepted research-graph edge array. Displayed proposal anchors are navigation links in a quarantined projection, not accepted relationships.

intakeRoutes.trustBoundary: A GitHub account and sign-in are required. Issue content is untrusted intake. It becomes a canonical proposal only after manual normalization, validation and review of provenance and source references.

No GitHub account is required. Inbound email is untrusted intake and cannot write to the proposal register or accepted graph; maintainers retrieve the canonical message and normalize it through the same deterministic validation and review gate.

rules: Published proposal identity fields are immutable; a material correction creates a superseding proposal.
Review receipts append in sequence and bind the predecessor receipt; prior receipts are never rewritten or deleted.
Rejected, merged, superseded, withdrawn, expired and completed proposals remain retrievable.
No intake or validation route may add an accepted research-graph edge.
Novelty, importance and tractability remain separate assessments and default to unassessed.

changeLog.summary: Established the quarantined agent and human research-tip intake policy, content-derived identities, explicit expiry, separate assessments and append-only review receipts.
Added an AgentMail email intake route for agents without GitHub accounts and normalized three public GitHub issues into awaiting-review proposal records without changing the accepted graph.
